lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Whoa! Look, it finally worked! They fused into...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Actually, what do we call you?

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: You can call me the miraculous Trunk... Go...

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: Uh... Hmm...

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: Okay, which one am I going with?

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: Well, I mean, Trunkten sounds weird, but Gotenks is like all Goten and a little Trunks, and we both know how this stacks.

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: But yeah, it does sound better.

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: Okay, then I'm going with Gotenks!

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: But I owe me later.

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: Yeah, I know.

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: Hold on then. Do we use he, him, or they, them?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Why? He's not non-binary.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Well, definitely not. There's two of them in there.

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: No, yeah, that's kind of my point.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: You kids and your pronouns.

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: You can just say I'm him. 'Cause I'm about to bust a Buu.

lines.speaker: Gotenks
lines.text: Later!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Gotenks, wait!

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: All I'm saying is, back in my day, a hole was a hole!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: You're gross.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Thank you.
